description: (Rb)₂NaPrI₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Rb clusters inside a NaPrI₆ framework. In each Rb cluster, Rb is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaPrI₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PrI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.14 Å. Pr is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form PrI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Pr-I bond lengths are 3.12 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Pr atom.
